notes: Tie structure of M = log2(tumour/normal) per patient, on gene index 1.0.0, epithelial cells only, genes non-zero in both arms. Answers a question raised reviewing PR #40: W2's within_bin_percentile computes ORDINAL ranks while its docstring promises average ranks, which makes a tied gene's percentile depend on array position. MS4A12 is the gene most exposed, because threshold 2 reads it and it is expected at M~0. NOT a G1 result — no threshold is evaluated here.
name: m_tie_structure
